nodes.label: Multi-Pair Backtest Results
nodes.description: 4-panel bar chart showing EMA50 Pullback backtest results across 8 currency pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD, AUDUSD, NZDUSD, USDJPY, USDCAD, EURJPY, GBPJPY). Panels: Profit Factor by pair (most below 1.2 threshold, GBPJPY above), Win Rate by pair (range ~29-40%), Total Result in R (positive for most except USDJPY and EURJPY), Maximum Drawdown in R by pair.

nodes.label: EMA50 Pullback Strategy
nodes.description: Trading strategy under test: EMA50 Pullback applied across multiple forex pairs in a multi-pair backtest.

nodes.label: Profit Factor by Pair
nodes.description: Bar chart panel showing Profit Factor per currency pair. Reference lines: Breakeven (1.0, red dashed), Boundary >=1.2 (orange dashed), Good >=1.5 (green dashed). GBPJPY exceeds 1.2 threshold; EURJPY below 1.0 (losing).

nodes.label: Win Rate by Pair
nodes.description: Bar chart panel showing Win Rate (%) per currency pair. Range approximately 29-40%. GBPJPY achieves ~40% (at orange reference line). EURJPY lowest at ~29%.

nodes.label: Total Result in R by Pair
nodes.description: Bar chart panel showing net result measured in R-multiples per pair. EURUSD ~+11R, GBPUSD ~+9R, AUDUSD ~+14R, NZDUSD ~+12R, USDJPY ~-5R, USDCAD ~+21R, EURJPY ~-20R, GBPJPY ~+16R.

nodes.label: Maximum Drawdown by Pair
nodes.description: Bar chart panel showing maximum drawdown in R per currency pair. USDCAD highest drawdown ~33R, EURUSD ~21R, USDJPY ~18R, NZDUSD ~16R, AUDUSD ~16R, GBPJPY ~15R, GBPUSD ~14R.
